cohort: Pregnant women at term (HIV-positive and HIV-negative) and their infants, recruited from the antenatal clinic at Lagos University Teaching Hospital.
finding: No significant association was found between maternal serum selenium concentration and infant birth weight in either HIV-positive or HIV-negative pregnant women, although HIV-positive women had lower mean serum selenium levels and their infants had lower mean birth weights.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight for infants of HIV-positive mothers was 2952g, and for HIV-negative mothers was 3392g.
